description: REGRESSION (2026-05-18): heap corruption after a thrown event crosses an inner unmatched typed catch arm and propagates to an outer catch.  Inner's `try { throw A() } catch B(e) {...}` dispatch used LoadLocal (snapshot, not consume) of the hidden error_local; the propagation path's function-exit CleanupHook then double-dropped the SAME pointer the caller was about to release via FnResult.Err, surfacing as `double free or corruption` or `malloc(): unaligned tcache chunk`.  Fix: emit MoveOut at the propagation site in `_visit_stmt_HTry` so the cleanup hook sees error_local as consumed.  Exit 0 = clean run; pre-fix the process aborts after main returns.
